zh.name: 画板孔雀
zh.desc: 诞生于绘师学校的异常，来自于「笔自己动起来画画」这个流言。\n集合了无才能绘师的自怨自艾、对上学的恐惧，人类的怠惰心…最终变成了现在这个样子。

skill_list.skill_desc: 对指定我方单体造成物理属性伤害。
对指定我方单体造成物理属性伤害，并消耗1点<u>【颜料】</u>造成对应属性的附加伤害。

250130303.name: 颜料
250130303.desc: 【画板孔雀】处于【色彩】状态施放技能时，会消耗【颜料】造成对应属性的附加伤害。每种属性对应一种【颜料】。

skill_list.skill_desc: 对我方全体造成物理属性伤害，并消耗1点<u>【颜料】</u>造成对应属性的附加伤害。

250130303.name: 颜料
250130303.desc: 【画板孔雀】处于【色彩】状态施放技能时，会消耗【颜料】造成对应属性的附加伤害。每种属性对应一种【颜料】。

skill_list.skill_desc: 对我方全体造成物理属性伤害，并消耗剩余所有<u>【颜料】</u>造成对应属性的附加伤害。

250130303.name: 颜料
250130303.desc: 【画板孔雀】处于【色彩】状态施放技能时，会消耗【颜料】造成对应属性的附加伤害。每种属性对应一种【颜料】。

skill_list.skill_desc:
<u>【无色】</u>状态下受到我方目标攻击后，根据攻击者的属性，获得1点<u>【颜料】</u>，如果在受到攻击时受到了欢愉伤害，则额外获得一定数量的<u>【颜料】</u>。
当<u>【颜料】</u>达到6点时，进入<u>【色彩】</u>状态。
处于<u>【无色】</u>状态时，韧性不会低于1点。
全属性抗性提高，弱点被击破时移除。从弱点击破状态恢复时重新获得。

250130301.name: 无色
250130301.desc: 受到我方目标攻击后，根据攻击者的属性，获得1点【颜料】，如果在受到攻击时受到了欢愉伤害，则额外获得一定数量的【颜料】。当【颜料】达到6点时，进入【色彩】状态，此时根据已获得的【颜料】的种类，获得对应属性的弱点并降低对应属性抗性。处于【无色】状态时，韧性不会低于1点。

250130302.name: 色彩
250130302.desc: 施放技能时，会消耗【颜料】造成对应属性的附加伤害，回合结束时若已消耗所有【颜料】，则进入【无色】状态，并移除由【颜料】带来的弱点和属性抗性降低。被击破时，消耗所有【颜料】对自身造成最大生命值一定百分比的附加伤害。

250130303.name: 颜料
250130303.desc: 【画板孔雀】处于【色彩】状态施放技能时，会消耗【颜料】造成对应属性的附加伤害。每种属性对应一种【颜料】。

skill_list.skill_desc: 消耗<u>【颜料】</u>对我方目标造成附加伤害时，若我方目标的属性与附加伤害的属性不同，则该附加伤害提高。

250130303.name: 颜料
250130303.desc: 【画板孔雀】处于【色彩】状态施放技能时，会消耗【颜料】造成对应属性的附加伤害。每种属性对应一种【颜料】。

skill_list.skill_desc: 进入<u>【色彩】</u>状态时，根据当前数量最多的<u>【颜料】</u>的数量，使我方获得一定数量的<u>笑点</u>，然后根据已获得的<u>【颜料】</u>的种类，获得对应属性的弱点，并降低对应属性抗性。\n处于<u>【色彩】</u>状态下回合结束时，若已消耗所有<u>【颜料】</u>，则进入<u>【无色】</u>状态。

10000027.name: 笑点
10000027.desc: 笑点为全队共享。造成欢愉伤害时，计入的笑点越多，欢愉伤害越高。

en.name: Canvas Peacock
en.desc: The aberration born in the art school originated from the rumor of "brushes moving and painting on their own."\nIt congregated the self-loathing of talentless artists, their fear of school, and humanity's inherent laziness... and ultimately became what it is today.

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals Physical DMG to one designated target.
Deals Physical DMG to one designated target and consumes 1 <u>"Paint"</u> to deal Additional DMG of the corresponding Type.

250130303.name: Paint
250130303.desc: "Canvas Peacock": When using abilities while in the "Color" state, "Paint" will be consumed to deal Additional DMG of the corresponding Type. Each Type corresponds to a different "Paint."

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals Physical DMG to all targets and consumes 1 <u>"Paint"</u> to deal Additional DMG of the corresponding Type.

250130303.name: Paint
250130303.desc: "Canvas Peacock": When using abilities while in the "Color" state, "Paint" will be consumed to deal Additional DMG of the corresponding Type. Each Type corresponds to a different "Paint."

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals Physical DMG to all targets and consumes all remaining <u>"Paint"</u> to deal Additional DMG of the corresponding Type.

250130303.name: Paint
250130303.desc: "Canvas Peacock": When using abilities while in the "Color" state, "Paint" will be consumed to deal Additional DMG of the corresponding Type. Each Type corresponds to a different "Paint."

skill_list.skill_desc:
After being attacked by ally targets while in the <u>"Colorless"</u> state, gains 1 point of <u>"Paint"</u> based on the attacker's Type. If Elation DMG is received during the attack, gains additional <u>"Paint"</u> points.
When <u>"Paint"</u> reaches 6 points, enters the <u>"Color"</u> state.
While in the <u>"Colorless"</u> state, Toughness will not drop below 1 point.
Increases All-Type RES, this effect is removed when Weakness is Broken and is regained when recovering from Weakness Break.

250130301.name: Colorless
250130301.desc: When attacked by ally targets, gains 1 point of "Paint" based on the attacker's Type. If Elation DMG is received during the attack, then additionally gains a certain amount of "Paint." When reaching 6 points of "Paint," enters the "Color" state. During this state, based on the Types of Paint already gained, gains corresponding Types of Weakness and decreases the Type RES of corresponding Type. When in the "Colorless" state, Toughness will not drop below 1.

250130302.name: Color
250130302.desc: When using abilities, "Paint" will be consumed to deal Additional DMG of the corresponding Type. At the end of the turn, if all "Paint" has been consumed, enters the "Colorless" state and removes Weakness and Type RES reduction caused by "Paint." When Weakness is Broken, consumes all "Paint" to deal Additional DMG equal to a percentage of this unit's max HP to this unit.

250130303.name: Paint
250130303.desc: "Canvas Peacock": When using abilities while in the "Color" state, "Paint" will be consumed to deal Additional DMG of the corresponding Type. Each Type corresponds to a different "Paint."

skill_list.skill_desc: When consuming <u>"Paint"</u> to deal Additional DMG to a target, if the target's Type differs from the Additional DMG Type, this Additional DMG is boosted.

250130303.name: Paint
250130303.desc: "Canvas Peacock": When using abilities while in the "Color" state, "Paint" will be consumed to deal Additional DMG of the corresponding Type. Each Type corresponds to a different "Paint."

skill_list.skill_desc: Upon entering the <u>"Color"</u> state, grants targets a set number of <u>Punchline</u> points based on the highest amount of a single type of <u>"Paint"</u>. Then, according to the Type of the already obtained <u>"Paint"</u>, gains the corresponding Type Weakness, and reduces corresponding Type RES.\nAt the end of the turn while in the <u>"Color"</u> state, if all <u>"Paint"</u> has been consumed, enters the <u>"Colorless"</u> state.

10000027.name: Punchline
10000027.desc: Punchline is shared by the whole team. When dealing Elation DMG, the more Punchline taken into account, the higher the Elation DMG.

At the end of the turn, if all "Paint" has been consumed, enters the "Colorless" state and removes Weakness and Type RES reduction caused by "Paint." When Weakness is Broken, consumes all "Paint" to deal Additional DMG equal to a percentage of this unit's max HP to this unit.

skill_list.skill_desc:
After being attacked by ally targets while in the <u>"Colorless"</u> state, gains 1 point of <u>"Paint"</u> based on the attacker's Type. If Elation DMG is received during the attack, gains additional <u>"Paint"</u> points.
When <u>"Paint"</u> reaches 6 points, enters the <u>"Color"</u> state.
While in the <u>"Colorless"</u> state, Toughness will not drop below 1 point.
Increases All-Type RES, this effect is removed when Weakness is Broken and is regained when recovering from Weakness Break.

250130301.name: Colorless
250130301.desc: When attacked by ally targets, gains 1 point of "Paint" based on the attacker's Type. If Elation DMG is received during the attack, then additionally gains a certain amount of "Paint." When reaching 6 points of "Paint," enters the "Color" state. During this state, based on the Types of Paint already gained, gains corresponding Types of Weakness and decreases the Type RES of corresponding Type. When in the "Colorless" state, Toughness will not drop below 1.
